prior_review8_p1.note: Receipt-first recovery now explicitly validates the complete DB lifecycle, replays a valid receipt despite a damaged post-COMMIT sidecar tail, marks the case sidecar_degraded, and blocks further writes. The explicit test matrix still lacks that full branch.

findings.title: No explicit restart test for receipt-present damaged-sidecar degraded recovery
findings.required_test: After verifying a committed DB transaction, corrupt/truncate the terminal sidecar tail; restart; assert authorized replay of the exact receipt after full DB lifecycle verification, sidecar_degraded state, and rejection of a fresh command with zero Planner/ExecuteTool/Registry calls. Also assert damaged sidecar plus unavailable receipt returns recovery_integrity_error.

findings.title: Filesystem ACL/path and key provisioning security negatives are specified but not assigned tests
findings.required_test: Enumerate wrong owner, inherited/extra ACE, weak POSIX mode/umask, symlink/reparse/hard-link/directory swap, pre-existing/replaced key, deterministic/cross-case key reuse, and no argv/environment/log/file leakage. Each case must fail before Prepare/Registry and cannot be reused.

findings.title: Opaque PilotToolPermit reuse and semantic-binding negatives lack direct assertions
findings.required_test: Attempt permit replay and mismatches for command, plan HMAC, attempt ID, effect index, and tool name; assert no Registry call, tool_result, or bundle. Preserve durable tool_started-before-handler barrier test.
